title: Model training method and face recognition method based on adaptive split learning-federated learning

pse.problem: The limitations of existing solutions in addressing heterogeneity issues among participating user devices and strengthening privacy protection for face recognition tasks.
pse.solution_function: Adaptive split learning-federated learning method that addresses heterogeneity by scheduling straggled devices, ensuring important data is included in training, and enhancing privacy protection through additional mechanisms without compromising system efficiency or model performance.
pse.solution_structure: User devices (with varying capabilities), central server, adaptive split learning modules.
pse.solution_implementation: Local data preprocessing on user devices, gradient calculation, scheduling of straggled devices, aggregation of gradients by the central server, model updates.
pse.effect: Improved efficiency and accuracy in face recognition tasks, enhanced privacy protection
